description: Committee recommends allowing temporary curbside parklets for public use.
Organizations would manage maintenance and apply annually.
Fees would apply in pay parking areas, free elsewhere.

chips.text: Parklets in pay parking areas would cost 18% of hourly rate.
Community associations will comment on residential parklet applications.
Establishes a formal framework for community parklets.
Broadway BID reported very positive feedback from businesses.
A complimentary report on rental fees will go to Council next month.
